title: vincetoxicum neglectum
intro: Vincetoxicum neglectum, commonly known as the "Wood Woad" or "Dog's Thumb", is a perennial plant in the Apocynaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Vincetoxicum neglectum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and modulate the immune response. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as vincetoxicin, which are responsible for its pharmacological properties.
